claim: Models optimized for structure-dependent PTM prediction may not generalize well to PTMs in highly disordered protein contexts.
falsifier: One could evaluate a structure-dependent PTM predictor on a benchmark of disordered region PTMs and compare performance to predictors designed for disordered contexts.

conditions: when the model relies on structural features from AlphaFold
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported system, task, population, and conditions; transfer beyond them is unestablished.

title: Optimization for structure-dependent PTM–generalization to PTMs boundary
